test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 11 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and decide if the given conclusion is true, false or irrelevant with respect to the statements.

**Statements:**

I. A is the sister of B.

II. B is the daughter of C.

**Conclusion:**

B is the enemy of C.
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

The statement is given below:-

I. A is the sister of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/11e5b4685351bb9ab72618d4597f334a713ba11114fa6250a0dded4aeaeb4b65.png] 

II. B is the daughter of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/377164bc8e1764355553d8e38693802355afd73d140f366ce41e771e3e3e5f09.png] 

From statements I and II the family tree is given below:-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/82f3a6f3400bf8b703facd98a8ad95cad5cf9d5e0ea38f54e3fe6e368648c897.png] 

From the above figure, we can say that A and B are sisters and C is either father or mother of A and B.

In conclusion, **B is the enemy of C cannot be drawn.**

Hence, **"option 3"** is the correct answer.
